label: Conquest claim
summary: A saved value named "conquest claim"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so the code that fills it is not visible here.

label: Conquest holy war
summary: A saved value named "conquest holy war"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Conquest populist
summary: A saved value named "conquest populist"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Rite edited by player
summary: Set in the on_action that fires when a faith's rite has been changed, only when the player made the change through the game's interface.
details: Script-made changes to a rite do not set it. Vanilla uses it as an existence check (`exists = scope:consume_rite_edit_token`) in the rite-changed on_action. It does not say what kind of value it holds.

label: Context
summary: A saved value named "context"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Contract
summary: The task contract the current script is about.
details: Vanilla saves it in important actions (common/important_actions/contract_actions.txt:90) and from `random_available_task_contract` in an adventurer AI effect. It is used over 100 times in vanilla.

label: Contract type
summary: The kind of contract the current script is about.
details: Vanilla saves it as a temporary scope inside a script value (common/script_values/00_basic_values.txt:1978); that is its only use.

label: Council task
summary: The council task the current script is about.
details: Vanilla saves it in two character interactions (common/character_interactions/00_vassal_interactions.txt:1849 and 06_ep3_interactions.txt:3591).

label: Councillor
summary: The councillor the current script is about.
details: Used very often in vanilla (over 1,800 times), mainly in council positions and council tasks. One place that saves it is the childhood on_actions, which save the host's councillor spouse under this name (common/on_action/childhood_on_actions.txt:764).

label: Councillor's liege
summary: The liege of the councillor the current script is about.
details: Vanilla saves it from `liege = { ... }` in an admin decision (common/decisions/dlc_decisions/ep_3/06_ep3_admin_decisions.txt:1688), and uses it widely in council positions and tasks.

label: County
summary: The county title the current script is about.
details: Used over 1,100 times in vanilla, for example in buildings and council tasks. The realm maintenance on_actions save it temporarily (common/on_action/realm_maintenance_on_actions.txt:22).

label: County converted
summary: A saved value named "county converted"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Court physician
summary: The court physician (the character holding that court position) in the current script.
details: Vanilla saves it in health, court and travel events (for example events/travel_events/travel_danger_events_filippa.txt:516).

label: Court populator
summary: A saved value named "court populator"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Court position type
summary: The kind of court position (such as physician or jester) the current script is about.
details: Vanilla saves it in a court position effect (common/scripted_effects/00_court_position_effects.txt:3423) and uses it in court position management events.

label: Courtier
summary: The courtier the current script is about.
details: Used over 200 times in vanilla, for example in character interactions (06_ep3_interactions.txt:11968) and courtier management.

label: Courts with language
summary: A number: how many royal courts use the same court language, counting the target's own court.
details: Given by the game's code to a culture script value and a scripted rule (common/script_values/00_culture_values.txt:683, common/scripted_rules/00_rules.txt:952); the script value uses it directly as its value.

label: Created
summary: A saved value named "created"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Creation reason
summary: Why a character was created, given to the on_action that fires when a character is created other than by birth.
details: It is a flag, so compare it with the `flag:` prefix. The reasons listed in vanilla's comments include script (the create_character effect), ruler_designer, pool, guests, court_populator, mercenary_companies, succession, grant_titles, great_holy_war and migration.

label: Creator
summary: The character who made the thing the script is about, such as an artifact or a legend.
details: Vanilla saves it in artifact creation effects (the creator passed in, or the artifact's owner) and uses it in legend types.

label: Culture
summary: The culture the current script is about.
details: Used nearly 400 times in vanilla, for example in coat of arms templates and legend events (events/dlc/ce1/legend_spread_events_nick.txt:49).

label: Current weight
summary: A number: the score the game's code has calculated for an artifact, when the AI decides what to equip.
details: Vanilla's comment on the artifact equip score script value says it is the score from the code's calculation. A clothing trigger compares it with 40 (common/scripted_triggers/00_clothing_triggers.txt:499 and 503).

label: Danger value
summary: A saved value named "danger value"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Dangerous
summary: A saved value named "dangerous"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Death
summary: A death (the record of a character dying) the current script is about.
details: Vanilla saves it in culture tradition events (for example events/culture_events/culture_tradition_events.txt:3337) and uses it in scripted effects of two expansions. Its exact kind is inferred from its name and uses.

label: Death reason
summary: Why a character is about to die, given to the on_action that fires just before a death.
details: Vanilla's comment on that on_action says the reason is set as this scope. Script compares death reasons by name, for example `death_reason = death_fight`.

label: Defender
summary: The character defending in a war, or the one a casus belli (a reason for war) would be used against.
details: The game itself gives it in casus belli types and groups, next to `scope:attacker`; in a running war it is the primary defender. When the game only checks whether a casus belli may be shown or used, it may not be set yet, so triggers should work without it. Vanilla reads it nearly 2,800 times.

label: Defender power
summary: A number: the combined maximum military power of everyone who would defend against a migration, scaled by their regiments' attack and toughness.
details: Given by the game's code in the migration interaction. Vanilla compares it with the migrating ruler's current military strength (common/character_interactions/09_mpo_interactions.txt:3261).

label: Defenders
summary: A list of all rulers who would be part of the migration war if the migration is declined.
details: It holds the holder of the main migration target and every ruler with land in the domain being taken. Given by the game's code in the migration interaction.

label: Depose
summary: A saved value named "depose"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Destination
summary: The place a character is going to, in courtier and guest management.
details: Vanilla saves it as the capital province of a title's holder (common/scripted_effects/00_courtier_guest_management_effects.txt:17) and uses it in the related on_actions.

label: Destiny type flag
summary: A flag naming the kind of destiny the player selected, given to the on_action that fires when the player confirms a destiny character.
details: In that on_action the root is the destiny character, who is already the player's character.

label: Destroyed
summary: A saved value named "destroyed"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Discoverer
summary: The character who discovered a secret; the game gives it to a secret type's `on_discover` effect.
details: Used 24 times in vanilla, in secret types; one check compares it with the real father (common/secret_types/00_bastard_secrets.txt:139). In `on_discover` the root is the secret.

label: Disobedient kurultai
summary: A list of all disobedient characters who took part in the kurultai election (both the council and the children).
details: Given by the game's code in the mpo (nomad expansion) on_actions; scripted rules and the on_action count its size (`list_size(disobedient_kurultai)`).

label: Diverged
summary: A yes/no value, only sometimes set, given when a new faith is created: yes if it was created because a rite diverged too far.
details: Set for the on_action that fires when a new faith is created. A heresy created at the start with 100 or more divergence does not count. Vanilla tests it as `scope:diverged ?= yes`, since it can be absent.

label: Doctrine
summary: The religious doctrine the current script is about.
details: Used 89 times in vanilla, in script values and scripted GUIs (for example a check `knows_doctrine = scope:doctrine` in common/scripted_guis/pam_scripted_guis.txt:132).

label: Doing
summary: A saved value named "doing"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Domain
summary: The county or duchy a migrating ruler aims to get as their new domain.
details: Given by the game's code in the migration interaction; it can be the same title as the main migration target. Vanilla also uses it in a test interaction.

label: Domain fertility
summary: A number: the total current fertility of the domain the migrating ruler would receive.
details: Given by the game's code in the migration interaction and also used in scripted rules.

label: Dread
summary: A yes/no value used in tributary and similar interactions; the game documents nothing more about it.
details: Vanilla only tests it as `scope:dread = yes` (for example common/character_interactions/00_tributary_interactions.txt:5842). What sets it is not shown.

label: Duel target
summary: A saved value named "duel target"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it. A similar name, `duel_value`, is used very often, but that is not evidence for this one.

label: Duel value
summary: A number-like value used heavily in activity and debug script; the game documents nothing about it.
details: Used over 4,400 times in vanilla, for example as `value = scope:duel_value` (common/character_interactions/00_debug_interactions.txt:2076). Its link to duels is inferred from its name only.

label: Dynasty
summary: The dynasty whose head just changed, in the new-dynasty-head on_action.
details: Vanilla's comment says the root is the new dynasty head and this scope is the dynasty affected.

label: Election
summary: A saved value named "election"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Employee
summary: The character working in a court position or task, as the script sees them.
details: Used over 200 times in vanilla, in court position types and tasks (for example the court jester tasks).

label: Employee aptitude
summary: A number the game gives when the AI weighs a court position: the aptitude of the courtier being considered (`scope:employee`), from 0 (terrible) to 4 (excellent).
details: Vanilla compares it with the highest aptitude among the available candidates (common/court_positions/types/00_court_positions.txt:545).

label: Employer
summary: The employer in the situation; for task contracts, the contract's employer.
details: In task contracts the game gives the contract's employer under this name; it can be empty. The root there is the contract's owner (or the existing contract, when the game checks whether a taken contract stays valid). Vanilla also uses it over 750 times in council tasks and governance on_actions, where the script that saved it decides who it is.

label: Enemy battle owner
summary: The owner of the opposing side in a battle, as saved by an artifact event.
details: Vanilla saves it in an artifact event (events/artifacts/artifact_events.txt:4016) and uses it 9 times. Its exact meaning is inferred from its name.

label: Enemy commander
summary: The commander of the opposing side in a battle, as saved by an artifact event.
details: Vanilla saves it in an artifact event (events/artifacts/artifact_events.txt:4004) and uses it 12 times, also in legend spread events. Its exact meaning is inferred from its name.

label: Epidemic
summary: The epidemic the current script is about.
details: Used over 100 times in vanilla, in the epidemic definitions and the ce1 on_actions.

label: Epidemic type
summary: The kind of epidemic the current script is about.
details: Vanilla uses it once, in common/script_values/06_ce1_epidemics_values.txt.

label: Estimated arrival difference (days)
summary: A number of days: the difference between when an activity starts and when the traveller is estimated to arrive; negative means arriving late.
details: Given by the game's code to the on_action that fires when a traveller will probably miss the activity's start; activity modifiers also use it (common/on_action/travel_on_actions.txt:2089).

label: Exposed
summary: A yes/no value the game gives to scheme scripts: whether the scheme is exposed.
details: Vanilla uses it 8 times. In the claim throne scheme, a modifier of -30 applies when it is true (common/schemes/scheme_types/claim_throne_scheme.txt:117, labelled "scheme is exposed").

label: Faction
summary: The faction the current script is about.
details: Used over 700 times in vanilla, mainly in the faction definitions.

label: Faction demand
summary: A saved value named "faction demand"; the game documents nothing about what it holds.
details: Vanilla script never saves or reads it, so its meaning is unknown.

label: Faction member
summary: A member of a faction, as the script sees them.
details: Used 62 times in vanilla, in events such as coronation prelude events and councillor spouse events.

label: Faith
summary: The faith the current script is about.
details: Used nearly 400 times in vanilla, for example in marriage interactions and coat of arms templates.

label: Father
summary: A father in the situation the script is about, usually a character's father.
details: Used over 220 times in vanilla, in child birth on_actions and bastard effects.

label: Favorite destiny character
summary: A character saved in the destiny selection on_actions; the game documents nothing more about it.
details: Vanilla saves it in several places in common/on_action/player_select_destiny_on_actions.txt and later checks `exists = scope:favorite_destiny_character` and compares characters with it. Its link to a favorite pick is inferred from its name.
